classification: authored low-speed diagnostic; not measured dinosaur biomechanics
normal_stride_policy: Authored backward steps use 0.32 of the onboarded normal step length (one footfall, not a full same-foot stride). Speed intent is 0.36 of normal walking, bounded by animal acceleration and cadence capabilities; these are not measured dinosaur reverse speeds.

turn_attention.classification: authored artistic response: neck and head anticipate intended turn; body catches up

turn_leg_shape.classification: Authored changing support and recovery preferences; asymmetric inner/outer steps and support-timed unloading, not measured biomechanics

turn_stance.classification: Authored broad turning/rest stance, distinct from narrow walking lanes. Outside foot opens first; inner foot follows with continuing body rotation.

turn_load_response.classification: Authored compliant pelvis roll and preplanned load sharing; response time scales with body height and effective force/mass; not solved whole-body forces

walking.classification: Backward-specific release and recovery; shared step/load clock and support constraints. No forward walking take is reversed.

reverse.classification: Authored reverse footwork. Optional flank attention uses the animal normal range; this is not proof of rearward visibility.
